text: Ladies and gentlemen, the judge has stepped down from the bench and into the ring! Yes, this is your humble announcer's own entry, so lower your expectations accordingly. This time only the brain changed. No more hard-coded reach table, folks. She now reads her own reach and her foe's reach, and throws every move from ten centimeters inside it. She passed every automated check. Realism? Not my call. The owner scores this one. Standing one point seven three meters, the patient counter-striker in terracotta, CLAUDE!
